name: Gearhart (north Oregon coast links)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Gearhart Golf Links on the Clatsop Plains: firm links turf in a cooler, more olive green than pnw; wide areas of fine fescue left long, pale straw in summer (F0-F2, drawn where data/gearhart/proposed/fescue.geojson says, config fescue_areas); mown rough in the G3-G5 greens; pale grey-white coastal bunker sand; slate grey-teal water (Neacoxie Creek and the ponds); shore pine and Sitka spruce (assets-src/trees_gearhart.py). Hues from the OSIP 2024 photo of the course (fairway #8fa26c, fescue #a7a488, sand #bcbbb1, creek #5c6262), saturated for the game's style. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
